messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High tail latency detected for streaming inference path (p95: 3200ms, p99: 9800ms) — affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Severity: S2. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall: got it, ack paging. pulling graphs now. anyone seeing errors?

sophie-eng: seeing a surge of 503s from config-fetch and auth-proxy in the control plane. spikes line up with p99 tail.

james-sre: also noticing DB connection queue growing on config-store primary (RDS read replicas healthy). 95th connection wait time ~1.6s.

mike-platform: logs show config-fetch latency skyrocketing for feature-flag reads. sample log: ```2026-03-15T15:04:12Z WARN config-fetch timeout=15000ms route=/v1/stream user=acct-823 status=504```.

irene-support: two customers reported streaming stalls and reconnect loops, they see partial tokens then gap. tracking customer-impact tickets #INC-7452, #INC-7453.

oncall: summary for execs? p95 3.2s, p99 ~9.8s, error ratio for streaming endpoints ~7%. Large clients on Dedicated seeing visible stalls.

james-sre: hypothesis: config-store auth calls are being rate-limited by token-store shard leading to cascading backpressure into inference path. Evidence: spike in auth-proxy 429s right before streaming stalls.

yusuf-ml: quantizer-side caching shouldn't cause this, this is upstream. also telemetry shows KV cache hit-rates are normal.

sophie-eng: reproduced locally by hammering config-fetch with token auth churn. seems feature-flag reads for experiments-service are hot.

mike-platform: mitigation options: 1) enable config fetch cache fallback (serve from snapshot) 2) temporarily raise token-store rate limits for control-plane routes 3) route streaming traffic to a warmed model variant without config calls.

oncall: can we enable snapshot fallback quickly?

sophie-eng: yes, there's a toggle in control plane: `controls.config.snapshot_fallback = true`. I'll flip it and monitor.

james-sre: while Sophie does that, I'll open additional DB connections to config-store (increase pool size from 200 -> 400) and add low-impact read replicas to handle reads. running command now: ```kubectl exec -n controlplane deploy/config-store -- bash -c \"export DB_POOL=400 && kill -HUP 1\"```.

sophie-eng: toggled snapshot_fallback=true. turning on per-route stale TTL 30s. watch metrics.

incident-bot: NOTE: snapshot_fallback toggled by sophie-eng at 2026-03-15T15:10:08Z.

mike-platform: I'm requesting a soft increase to token-store rate limits for control-plane-auth: sending PR to infra. If approved, will roll for 10m window.

irene-support: after snapshot fallback, customer reconnect rate dropped by ~60%, streaming stall errors decreased. still some p99 outliers.

yusuf-ml: what about the feature-flag hotkeys? maybe an experiment causing hot reads. Can we throttle experiments-service?

sophie-eng: identified a runaway rollout: experiments-service is reading flags per-token instead of per-session for certain clients. I pushed a temporary patch to cache flags per-session in the service. Deploying canary now.```

james-sre: canary looks good, CPU stable, latency improving. I'm still seeing occasional 5-10s tails — likely remaining auth 429s from token-store.

mike-platform: infra approved soft rate bump. Applied 2x rate limit for control-plane-auth keys for 15m window. Monitoring.

incident-bot: ACTION: rate-limit override applied by mike-platform at 2026-03-15T15:18:40Z.

oncall: after these mitigations p95 is down to 380ms, p99 down to 1.4s. error ratio 0.8%. Customer-impact tickets updated. Good progress.

irene-support: notifying affected customers: sent status update to BigRetailCo and HealthAI. both acknowledged and are monitoring.

dana-product: log note: feature-flag rollback for experiments rollout id=exp-2026-03-14-7 is recommended so we don't have recurrence.

sophie-eng: rolling back that rollout now. will monitor config-store reads.

james-sre: post-rollback read traffic for feature flags dropped ~85%. DB queue length back to normal. No further 429s.

oncall: preparing handoff to night oncall in 1 hour. we'll keep snapshot_fallback on for now and schedule a controlled rollback of rate-limit override.

mike-platform: I'll add longer-term fixes: rate-limit per-customer smoothing, better config-store caching, and a control-plane circuit-breaker to cut calls to experiments-service under load.

yusuf-ml: also add an eval to Redwood Optimize to catch high-frequency flag reads in production traces so we can surface dangerous rollout patterns.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to S3 at 2026-03-15T15:35:12Z. Root cause preliminary: runaway experiments rollout causing excessive feature-flag reads, cascading to token-store rate limits and config-store DB queueing.

oncall: final checklist before handoff: 1) snapshot_fallback=true (persisted) 2) rollback exp rollout (done) 3) token-store override revert scheduled in 15m 4) follow-up runbook entry created.

irene-support: tickets updated and customers notified. closing customer-facing incident doc draft.

james-sre: adding postmortem stub and tagging eng, platform, and product. will fill in timeline and mitigation details.

oncall: thanks all. handoff note to night team: watch for config-store read latency, auth 429s, and customer reconnects. contact list in handoff: james-sre, sophie-eng, mike-platform.

incident-bot: HANDOFF: oncall -> night-oncall at 2026-03-15T15:52:09Z.

sophie-eng: leaving some quick commands in the runbook: 
```
# snapshot fallback toggle
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/admin/toggles -d '{"snapshot_fallback": true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'

# increase DB pool (temporary)
kubectl set env deploy/config-store DB_POOL=400 -n controlplane

# quick check for auth 429s
kubectl logs -l app=auth-proxy -n controlplane --since=10m | grep 429 | wc -l
```

oncall: good runbook. will add the revert timeline for rate-limit override and cleanup tasks.

dana-product: capture learnings: make rollouts default to session-level flag cache, surface per-flag read counts in console, and add pre-rollout chaos test for flag-read amplification.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (provisionally) at 2026-03-15T15:55:29Z — follow-up tasks created in backlog: RD-1087 (runbook), RD-1088 (feature-flag safeguards), RD-1089 (control-plane circuit-breaker).
